purpose: Inventory of PSDK local persistence that defines the safe JSON boundary. It does not enable remote restoration.

entries.identity: The local GamePlay::Save byte stream, beginning with the configured DUNCR header.
entries.type: Header plus a Ruby Marshal payload, optionally XOR-transformed by saveKey.
entries.restrictions: Never accept Marshal data from a remote source. A nonzero saveKey is reversible obfuscation, not encryption.

entries.identity: PFM::GameState, the root local state object.
entries.type: Ruby object graph with globals, map state, player state, and plugin extensions.
entries.restrictions: Do not encode the object graph directly. Rebuild only from independently validated entries, then call the runtime load lifecycle.

entries.identity: Game_Switches exposed as $game_switches.
entries.type: Boolean values indexed by switch ID.
entries.restrictions: Keep explicit false values; omission is not equivalent to false.
entries.evidence: RMXP global state and PFM::GameState global bindings.

entries.identity: Game_Variables exposed as $game_variables.
entries.type: Integer values indexed by variable ID.
entries.restrictions: Preserve IDs, values, defaults, and out-of-range access semantics. Reject values outside the supported integer domain.
entries.evidence: RMXP global state and PFM::GameState global bindings.

entries.identity: Game_SelfSwitches keyed by map, event, and switch.
entries.type: Boolean values keyed by a composite event identity.
entries.restrictions: Use an ordered tuple [map_id, event_id, switch_id]; never stringify the key.
entries.evidence: RMXP event state and PFM::GameState global bindings.

entries.identity: Project self variables keyed by map, event, and variable.
entries.type: Composite keys with values that may be Ruby objects.
entries.restrictions: Reject until an adapter defines reversible tuple keys and an explicit allowlist of value types.
entries.evidence: Project self-variable extension and PFM::GameState global bindings.

analysis.runtime_default: Only the containing data structure may be empty when the field is absent; no default is justified for individual values.
analysis.observations: The isolated base contains 9 DUNCR files: 5 have no entries, 3 have one nil-valued entry, and 1 has 107 heterogeneous entries.
analysis.inference: A missing key and a present key whose value is nil must remain distinct; observed values are not universal defaults.
analysis.sources: scripts/psdk_scripts/1_RMXP_Scripts.rb:2161-2170; read-only aggregate inspection of Saves/Critter_Party-* in the issue-27 worktree.

entries.identity: Trainer profile, party, actors, stored Critters, inventory, Bestiary, and quests.
entries.type: PSDK domain objects with cross-references and game-data identifiers.
entries.restrictions: Use versioned adapters with explicit IDs and scalar fields. Reject unknown species, moves, items, quest states, and cross-references.

entries.identity: Persistent system, screen, and player data including map position and direction.
entries.type: PSDK and RMXP runtime objects.
entries.restrictions: Encode only documented persistent fields such as map ID, coordinates, direction, timer, and restrictions. Exclude live graphics and callbacks.

entries.identity: Current map definitions, event pages, followers, and selected event state.
entries.type: Map resources plus transient Game_Event instances.
entries.restrictions: Reload map definitions from the installed game and restore only the explicitly captured event state. Do not serialize live Game_Event objects.

entries.identity: Per-map and per-event erase state.
entries.type: Environment state separate from a live event object.
entries.restrictions: Preserve map and event IDs. Verify behavior after map setup; do not infer that every runtime erase is persistent.

entries.identity: Map, battle, and parallel-event interpreter progress.
entries.type: Instruction pointers, branches, waits, children, and possible fibers.
entries.restrictions: Do not promise resumption in the middle of an event. Resume only from a separately specified safe checkpoint.
entries.evidence: RMXP interpreter and map engine lifecycle.

entries.identity: Game temporary state, graphics, callbacks, and live scene references.
entries.type: Runtime-only objects and callbacks.
entries.restrictions: Never encode runtime objects, callbacks, fibers, graphics, or scene references.
entries.evidence: GamePlay::Save pre-save cleanup and RMXP runtime state.

entries.identity: PFM::GameState user_data extension storage.
entries.type: Arbitrary Ruby Hash values.
entries.restrictions: Reject arbitrary Hash values until each key has a versioned adapter and an allowlisted value schema.

analysis.runtime_default: {} when the field is absent or nil, as applied by the runtime initializer/expander.
analysis.observations: All 9 inspected DUNCR files contain user_data; the observed keys are follower_pos and tjn_events, with scheduled_for_cleanup in 2 files.
analysis.inference: The empty Hash is a conditional repair value only; existing keys and values must not be added, removed, or normalized.
analysis.sources: scripts/psdk_scripts/4_Systems_000_General_3_GameState.rb:156-164; read-only aggregate inspection of Saves/Critter_Party-* in the issue-27 worktree.

entries.identity: PFM::GameState pathfinding request queue.
entries.type: Live pathfinding request objects.
entries.restrictions: Never serialize live pathfinding requests; recreate a request only through a future explicit gameplay action.

analysis.runtime_default: [] via Pathfinding::DEFAULT_SAVE; the runtime also applies it when the field is nil.
analysis.observations: All 9 inspected DUNCR files contain an empty pathfinding request array.
analysis.inference: An absent or nil field may be rebuilt as []; non-empty live requests must not be serialized or inferred from the sample.
analysis.sources: scripts/psdk_scripts/4_Systems_000_General_3_GameState.rb:131-132; scripts/psdk_scripts/4_Systems_003_Map_Engine.rb:8121-8123; read-only aggregate inspection of Saves/Critter_Party-* in the issue-27 worktree.

entries.identity: PFM::GameState Nuzlocke plugin state.
entries.type: Plugin-defined state with project-specific invariants.
entries.restrictions: Reject until an adapter defines its supported fields, identifiers, migrations, and reconstruction procedure.

analysis.runtime_default: A newly constructed object uses empty catch_locked_zones and graveyard arrays and false for no_lock_on_duplicate; the expander repairs graveyard and reconnects game_state.
analysis.observations: All 9 inspected DUNCR files show empty catch_locked_zones and graveyard and false no_lock_on_duplicate.
analysis.inference: These are constructor/repair defaults, not proof that arbitrary or unknown Nuzlocke state may be replaced with them.
analysis.sources: scripts/psdk_scripts/4_Systems_000_General_3_GameState.rb:115-122; scripts/psdk_scripts/4_Systems_204_Nuzlocke.rb:15-20; read-only aggregate inspection of Saves/Critter_Party-* in the issue-27 worktree.

entries.identity: PFM::GameState berry storage and growth state.
entries.type: Game-data-indexed collection with plugin-specific values.
entries.restrictions: Reject until an adapter defines the supported berry keys and values, validation rules, and migration policy.

analysis.runtime_default: {} when a new GameState is initialized; missing map entries are created lazily.
analysis.observations: All 9 inspected DUNCR files contain 3 to 6 map hashes; populated entries are arrays of 8 integers and several map hashes are empty.
analysis.inference: Only the missing top-level collection may default to {}; berry entry arrays must not be filled from observed values, and stage_time=0 remains invalid.
analysis.sources: scripts/psdk_scripts/4_Systems_000_General_3_GameState.rb:170-172; scripts/psdk_scripts/4_Systems_003_Map_Engine.rb:3502-3514,3541-3544; read-only aggregate inspection of Saves/Critter_Party-* in the issue-27 worktree.

entries.identity: PFM::GameState current Game_Troop battle state.
entries.type: Live battle runtime object.
entries.restrictions: Do not serialize a live battle troop. Rebuild only from a separately specified safe battle checkpoint.

entries.identity: PFM::GameState maximum level limit for allied Pokemon.
entries.type: Configuration-dependent integer.
entries.restrictions: If absent or nil, use Configs.settings.max_level; do not use the observed value 100 as a universal default.
entries.evidence: PFM::GameState level_max_limit initializer and expander in scripts/psdk_scripts/4_Systems_000_General_3_GameState.rb:168-169.

analysis.observations: The observed value was 100 in the inspected DUNCR files.
analysis.inference: The configured runtime value, not the sample value, is the only justified fallback.
analysis.sources: scripts/psdk_scripts/4_Systems_000_General_3_GameState.rb:168-169; read-only aggregate inspection of Saves/Critter_Party-* in the issue-27 worktree.

entries.identity: Optional mystery-gift state found in some save graphs.
entries.type: Optional version-dependent payload.
entries.restrictions: Permit absence; do not invent content or silently discard a present value until an adapter defines its schema.
entries.evidence: Read-only aggregate inspection of the DUNCR files available in the issue-27 worktree.

analysis.observations: The field was absent from all 9 DUNCR files in the isolated #13 base.
analysis.inference: Absence may be accepted as optional, but this base does not establish a universal presence or payload rule.
analysis.sources: Read-only aggregate inspection of Saves/Critter_Party-* in the issue-27 worktree; no game load performed.

entries.identity: PFM::GameState tint-time initialization marker.
entries.type: Symbol or nil.
entries.restrictions: Allow only a Symbol or nil; nil selects the runtime default and must not be coerced to false or to an observed Symbol.

analysis.runtime_default: nil means use the default time set.
analysis.observations: All 9 inspected DUNCR files contain the Symbol :platinum_daynight.
analysis.inference: The observed Symbol is not a universal default; preserve nil as a meaningful state.
analysis.sources: scripts/psdk_scripts/4_Systems_000_General_3_GameState.rb:154-155; read-only aggregate inspection of Saves/Critter_Party-* in the issue-27 worktree.

entries.identity: State registered by active plugins, including crafting.
entries.type: Plugin-defined Ruby objects with plugin-specific invariants.
entries.restrictions: Reject unless the installed plugin supplies a versioned adapter, allowed-value schema, reconstruction procedure, and migration policy.
entries.evidence: Crafting PFM extension in scripts/00000 Plugins/00001 Crafting/000_PFM.rb.

entries.identity: Save-slot binding, game version, PSDK version, and JSON schema version.
entries.type: Versioned scalar metadata.
entries.restrictions: Require an exact supported schema and explicit migration. Reject unknown future versions without silently dropping fields.
entries.evidence: GamePlay::Save metadata updates and PFM::Trainer save metadata.
